content.title: Future-Driven Integration Architecture
content.content:
Airbus Helicopters' integration platform must support not only current requirements but also future architectural evolution: API-first integration patterns, event-driven architectures, real-time data streaming, and agentic AI workflows. Informatica PowerCenter was designed for batch ETL in the pre-cloud, pre-API era. SnapLogic was purpose-built for the API economy with native support for REST APIs, event streams (Kafka, message buses), webhook receivers, and real-time data pipelines. This architectural foundation positions SnapLogic to support Airbus's integration roadmap for the next 5–10 years — not just replicate existing PowerCenter capabilities.

**B.7: Strategic - Looking for Partners to Innovate Airbus**

Airbus Helicopters is not looking for a vendor to replicate legacy capabilities. Airbus is looking for a partner to enable innovation: AI-assisted integration development, Citizen Integrator enablement, modern containerized architecture, API-first integration patterns. SnapLogic delivers this strategic vision today — with SnapGPT in production, Ground Plex running on OpenShift, and proven deployment experience in aerospace/defense manufacturing environments. Informatica PowerCenter delivers legacy replication; SnapLogic delivers strategic transformation.
